column1: # The corpus of the user-path gate (T-243): jobs of real public projects
# at pinned commits, run with `podrunner run WORKFLOW --checkout . --job
# JOB` in a clone of the commit (scripts/user-gate.py).
#   id        the name of the job in the results
#   workflow  the workflow file in the clone
#   job       the id of the job (--job)
#   github    the result of the job on github.com at the commit
#   executor  podvm (the run.toml of the installer), runner-dir or microvm
#   lanes     the lanes that run the row (a,b), or * for each lane
#   expect    ok, or xfail when podrunner fails the job by design (the note
#   flags     more flags of run, separated by a space, or -
#   BurntSushi/ripgrep ci.yml, run 42697207428 (push): rustfmt and docs success
#   expressjs/express ci.yml, run 41517558311 (push): Lint and Node.js 22 - ubuntu-latest success
#   rq/rq lint.yml, run 43349194961, and valkey.yml, run 43349194984 (push): each job success
# The executors run the larger runner image (install --full): the jobs need
# a C compiler and the tools of ubuntu-latest.
